title: Palisades (Holtec restart): External_Sender Holtec Palisades Emergency License Amendment Request for Alternative Fuel Handling Method [['E-Mail']]

documents.text:
From:           Tim Judson
To:             Marlayna Doell
Cc:             Diane D"Arrigo
Subject:        [External_Sender] Holtec Palisades Emergency License Amendment Request for Alternative Fuel Handling Method
Date:           Thursday, October 8, 2026 4:12:51 PM



Dear Ms. Doell,

The Nuclear Information and Resource Service opposes the request of Holtec Palisades
to bypass, on an “emergency” basis, procedures for environmental reviews, technical
reviews, cost analysis, and post-accident review for a license amendment that would
allow for use of an “alternative fuel handling method” following the mishandling of an
irradiated fuel assembly during fuel loading several weeks ago. There is no emergency
justification for the requested amendment, and NRC should deny it. Either the fuel
assembly in question is undamaged and no alternative procedure is necessary; or it is
damaged and its condition should be thoroughly examined before it is loaded into the
reactor.

Sincerely,
Timothy Judson

Executive Director
Nuclear Information and Resource Service
P.O. Box 8, Mount Rainier, MD, 20712
301-270-6477
